stemBlocks: The diagram shows two gametes, gamete P and gamete Q, fusing to form cell R in a healthy human. R divides to form two cells, S and T. S and T grow into two separate individuals.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

1 The number of double strands of DNA is the same in gamete P and cell T.
2 If gamete Q contains a Y chromosome, then both individuals that grow from cells S and T will be genetically male.
3 A mutation in the DNA in cell R before mitosis will always change the phenotype of cell S.

assets.alt: Diagram showing gamete P and gamete Q fusing to form cell R, which then divides into cells S and T.
